title: Sparse Network Inference under Imperfect Detection and its Application to Ecological Networks
abstract: arXiv:2604.18820v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recovering latent structure from count data has received considerable attention in network inference, particularly when one seeks both cross-group interactions and within-group similarity patterns in bipartite networks, which are widely used in ecology research. Such networks are often sparse and prone to imperfect detection. Existing models mainly focus on interaction recovery, while the induced similarity graphs are much less studied. Moreover, existing models for under-counted data place sparsity, if at all, on the detection model rather than on these graphs. To address these issues, we propose a nonnegative low-rank factorization framework that jointly estimates detection probabilities and promotes sparse within- and cross-group graphs through $\ell_{1/2}$ regularization. For the resulting nonconvex, nonsmooth problem, we develop an ADMM-based algorithm with adaptive penalization, and establish asymptotic feasibility and KKT stat

translated_title: 不完美检测下的稀疏网络推断及其在生态网络中的应用
translated_abstract: 从计数数据中恢复潜在结构在网络推断领域受到了相当大的关注，尤其是当人们希望同时在二部网络中获取跨群体交互作用和群体内相似性模式时——这类网络在生态学研究中被广泛使用。此类网络通常较为稀疏且易受不完美检测的影响。现有模型主要聚焦于交互关系的恢复，而对由此产生的相似性图的研究则少得多。此外，针对计数不足数据的现有模型即使考虑稀疏性，也只是将其施加于检测模型而非这些图上。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一个非负低秩分解框架，该框架联合估计检测概率，并通过 ℓ_{1/2} 正则化促进群体内与跨群体图的稀疏性。针对由此产生的非凸、非光滑问题，我们开发了一种带自适应惩罚的 ADMM 算法，并建立了渐近可行性与 KKT 条件……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出非负低秩分解框架，通过 ℓ_{1/2} 正则化在联合估计检测概率的同时促进生态二部网络中群体内与跨群体图的稀疏性，并设计了自适应惩罚的 ADMM 算法来求解该非凸非光滑问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a nonnegative low-rank factorization framework that jointly estimates detection probabilities and induces sparse within- and cross-group graphs via ℓ_{1/2} regularization for ecological bipartite networks, solved by an ADMM algorithm with adaptive penalization.
